help.stdout:
usage: gnd discover [-h] --out OUT --report REPORT --actor ACTOR
                    --requested-at REQUESTED_AT [--families FAMILIES]
                    [--max-values MAX_VALUES] [--max-pairs MAX_PAIRS]
                    [--format {text,json}]
                    model population

Propose candidate constraints of seven families (uniqueness, mandatory, value,
frequency, subset, equality, exclusion) that hold in one population. A
candidate is kept only when `gnd check` passes it with support > 0 and the
model neither declares nor entails it. Writes a discovery report and, when
anything is emitted, a `gnd evolve` proposal of induced, proposed, deontic
constraints: admission stays a reviewed act. Exits 0 on success (also with
nothing emitted), 3 on an invalid model or population, 64 on a usage error, 66
on a missing input, 70 on an internal defect, 74 on a refused output path.

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file
  population            path to the population file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT             write the evolve proposal here
  --report REPORT       write the discovery report here
  --actor ACTOR         who requests the proposal (its audit actor_id)
  --requested-at REQUESTED_AT
                        when, as ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (the audit time;
                        keeps output reproducible)
  --families FAMILIES   comma-separated subset of the seven families (default:
                        all)
  --max-values MAX_VALUES
                        largest distinct-value count for a value candidate
                        (default 20)
  --max-pairs MAX_PAIRS
                        most unordered role pairs compared for
                        subset/equality/exclusion (default 256)
  --format {text,json}  output rendering: human-readable text (default) or one
                        JSON payload
